# OpenFGA

> OpenFGA is a CNCF open source authorization system for fine-grained, relationship-based access control.

Use product documentation for current behavior and the OpenAPI specification for exact HTTP request and response shapes.

## Start Here

- [Introduction to OpenFGA](https://openfga.dev/docs/fga.md)
- [Getting Started](https://openfga.dev/docs/getting-started.md)
- [Set Up OpenFGA](https://openfga.dev/docs/getting-started/setup-openfga/overview.md)
- [Get Started with Modeling](https://openfga.dev/docs/modeling/getting-started.md)
